headline: Cowork Chat covers the in-product chat experience — conversation panel, composer, agent tooling, code execution and file deliverables — and of its 11 tickets the code review confirmed 3 (the streaming chat panel with history, and saving/revising deliverable files into the workspace), while the remaining 8 could not be settled from the code that was examined.
what_is_there: The code shows a working chat loop that streams replies incrementally and keeps conversation history, plus an agent tool that writes finished deliverables (documents, spreadsheets, text and CSV files) into a workspace output folder, overwrites a file when the same name is re-saved, and can produce several files in one session.
what_is_unclear: The user-interface side of the area — the composer with file/link/image attachments, the per-tab model picker and skill attachment control, the output file tree, the terminal panel, and stop/cancel handling — was not confirmed, because the interface files that would settle it were never opened during the review; likewise the sandboxed code runner and the Code agent's file read/write/edit tools, where only configuration and an intentionally empty rule document were seen. The in-progress "Superpowers" item has no description beyond its title, so there was nothing concrete to check it against.
suggested_action: Ask the team to point the next review at the Cowork tab's interface and code-execution code so the composer, model picker, output tree, terminal and cancel behaviour can be checked directly, and ask for a one-line description of what the in-progress "Superpowers" item is meant to deliver.
caveat: Several of the documents consulted during the review were flagged as describing a different codebase, so any absences they mention should not be read as evidence about this product.
